# R5.6 — Recoverable launch and subject funding binding

**⚠️ Recorded Deviation:** this PR measures **1,284 changed source/test
lines vs the ≤850 flag** (~1.5×). The worker stopped at the split trigger;
the scoped split review adjudicated **AMEND** — one atomic `launch_bound`
unit, no documented owner seam — ruling `d6b574ac` (dated note on the
contract, manifest row-175 note, LEDGER PHASE LOG). Accepted as recorded
Deviation per the contract's Amended 2026-11-02 ruling.

## Summary

Lands the admitted PADR-R5-1 (GATE-G9) recoverable launch record on the
experiment/budget owner seam: `launch` now runs persist intent →
allocate/open → bind subject/root → publish → arm, so a kill at any
persistence boundary recovers to exactly one subject/root/slice binding or
the owned idempotent `abort_launch` release — never a second subject,
never orphan spend, never a duplicate publication.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs` — `measurement.experiment.launch_bound`
  registered (`row_prov`; P7 plane home via the measurement family).
- `crates/hh-experiment/src/{events,view,errors,engine}.rs` — phased
  `launch_bound{intent|bound|aborted}` payloads + `inputs`/`grade_binding`
  builders; `LaunchBinding` fold; typed `LaunchBindingConflict`/
  `OrphanLaunchFunding`; launch restructure with deterministic
  `lbi-/subj-<idp>` ids (S4.6 precedent), adopt-or-refuse slice, subject
  `pool` root distinct from the funding slice (REQ-E-207), `LaunchPhase`
  fault seam, `abort_launch`, `launch_binding` reader.
- `crates/hh-embed/src/experiment_ops.rs` — launch response +
  `intent_ref`/`subject_root_budget_id` (additive, no schema edit).
- `crates/hh-experiment/tests/engine.rs` — 8-test R5.6 battery.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0385` — owned landing decisions.
